name: Enchantment Numbers Fix
qol: Consistent Roman numeral display for levels over 10 in tooltips and book names
editor_notes: Pack author's own mod (chimericdream). Needs Architectury API. Only relevant when levels exceed 10 (commands, datapacks, other mods).
summary: Shows enchantment levels above 10 as Roman numerals (e.g. Sharpness XV) instead of decimal numbers. Purely cosmetic and client-side.
